applicabilityBasis.summary: mAPOLLO is a performance-linked blockchain-based investment certificate issued by Midas Software GmbH. Its July 17, 2026 final terms link value to the ACM International Ltd reference portfolio and identify Swiss-law ledger-based securities. Redemption follows underlying portfolio performance or NAV and does not promise a fixed USD 1 payment obligation. The documented debt-security/investment-certificate structure supports the tracker excluded-security classification.

genius.licensingRegulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority under the EU Prospectus Regulation; Midas Software GmbH is not FMA-licensed)
genius.notes: GENIUS section 2(22) requires payment or settlement use, an obligation to redeem for fixed monetary value, and a stable-value representation; it separately excludes securities defined by the specified U.S. securities laws. This is a tracker perimeter assessment of the documented investment certificate, not a U.S. securities ruling. FMA prospectus approval does not establish MiCA issuer authorization or GENIUS approval. Current Midas eligibility documentation excludes U.S. citizens and residents. The token-specific reserve API reopened on October 7, 2026 reports issuer portfolio positions, assets, liabilities and equity, with an October 7 source timestamp. These are issuer disclosures and do not establish independent monthly accountant assurance. Redemption follows NAV rather than a fixed 1:1 USD obligation.
